hints.title: Node Association Registry
hints.text: Maintain an association dictionary mapping every original node to its cloned counterpart.

hints.title: Two-Pass or Memoized Traversal
hints.text: Clone node objects in a first pass or memoize on visit to instantiate nodes before linking random pointers.

hints.title: Child and Random Pointer Assignment
hints.text: Wire copy.left, copy.right, and copy.random using the populated hash table.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Each tree node is cloned once and stored in the hash map, leading to linear time and space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing random pointers without memoization can cause infinite cycles and duplicate node creation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table lookup prevents cycles and duplicate allocation for visited nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Memoized DFS cloning handling left, right, and random pointers identically.
